integrity: Exact symbolic identities, numerical quadrature and independent discrete optimization support the self-contained analytic proof; the computations are finite checks and no independent audit or publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional reflected-to-absorbing Itô diffusion with zero drift, fixed spatial mean and positive finite two-sided diffusivity bounds; mean absorption time only, no result for other stochastic conventions, higher dimensions or higher passage-time moments.
title: A sharp saturation threshold for bounded-diffusivity first-passage design
